g.text: DNS resolves first; HTTPS then stays on the tailnet
Cilium retains ownership of the hubble-ui Service.
Helm installs ingress-nginx; chart Service is disabled.
Ingress/hubble-ui defines routing and the TLS Secret.
Tailscale operator advertises its VIP through lab-ingress.
Cloudflare hosts DNS only; it never proxies Hubble application traffic.
NGINX sees the proxy Pod IP, not the original tailnet client IP.
